lead_raw_text:
The structure of Mn2B4Ir4 (Mn(BC)2Ir2) crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6_3/mmc (No. 194), with 10 atoms per unit cell distributed over 3 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies carbon centers with 9 geometric neighbors (2 B, 4 Ir, 3 Mn), boron centers with 10 neighbors (3 B, 1 C, 4 Ir, 2 Mn), and manganese centers with 12 neighbors (10 B, 2 C). The periodic neighbor graph forms a single 3-dimensional component spanning all 10 sites, and validated polyhedron contacts show corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among boron 10-vertex polyhedra, with corner- and edge-sharing between boron and manganese polyhedra.
